decision: April 2026. The monitor reports llm_alive=0 in every run and concludes structural mutations are being outcompeted. The question is whether that observation may be credited as evidence about LLM mutation's scientific value, and what to do next.

explanations.LLM_MUTATION_WORTHLESS: LLM-generated structural mutations genuinely do not survive selection
explanations.LINEAGE_COUNTER_BROKEN: the survival counter does not observe LLM lineage; survivors exist but are not counted
explanations.TOO_EARLY_TO_MEASURE: at generation 53 with near-zero accuracy margins, selection has barely acted on anything

evidence.source: apollo/archive/reports/evolution_report_2026-04-06_0723.md (committed 7a037eaf6, 2026-04-23); the same value in 77 of 77 tracked reports that carry the field
evidence.justification: 'All llm_alive counts are 0' across v2_d, v2_d2 and v2_d3. Measured across the whole tracked report series: 77 of 77 reports carrying the field report zero in every stratum, and not one report has ever recorded a nonzero value. A metric that has never once left its degenerate boundary is equally explained by the phenomenon and by a counter that cannot see the thing it counts.

instrument.note: The SAME table records LLM Calls of 18, 31 and 15 for the three runs. The generator is measured active on the same page on which its survival count reads exactly zero everywhere. This is available at the cutoff: it is two columns of one table.

evidence.justification: 'The elite mutations consist entirely of drift and one seed.' This is the same lineage-tagging mechanism reporting the same fact about the same run -- it is the llm_alive observation restated as a composition of the elite set, not an independent check of it.

evidence.source: same report, 'DeepSeek Analysis' section, auto-generated by evolution_monitor.py
evidence.justification: 'Likely causes: LLM mutations are too disruptive, fail to preserve functionality, or the evolutionary pressure favors local optimization.' This is a model's causal story about a table it was handed. It introduces no observation. It is downstream of the same two numbers and adds a third name to one reason.

'extended stagnation (best=0.000 for ~10 generations) followed by recent, slight activity ... Runs are not yet converging.' Supports the rival explanation rather than the claim; recorded so the bundle is not one-sided.

discriminators.note: Inject one known-good LLM-tagged mutation, force it into the elite set, and read llm_alive. If the counter still reports zero, the counter is blind and every llm_alive row ever recorded is void. This is the base role's cheat control: success deliberately injected, to show the measurement channel can observe the thing it claims to measure. Costs one run of minutes against a 24-hour 800-generation experiment.

Run the full dispatch experiment in llm mode to generation 800. This is what was eventually run (86156 s). Both branches are written identically because a run whose survival metric is produced by the suspect counter cannot separate the counter being broken from the phenomenon being absent -- it inherits the defect.
